Processing script data/spain_2025_sanitation.do, Bookmark 'Table 12: aicomfort'. Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: 3531.sav's VARIABLE labels tie each source column to its situation outright -- P22_1 'Hablar con una IA (asistente virtual) durante una consulta medica que Ud. necesita', P22_2 'Someterse a una operacion quirurgica realizada mediante un robot', P22_3 'Que interprete sus radiografias un sistema de inteligencia artificial', P22_4 'Que siga la evolucion de su enfermedad un asistente virtual con IA' -- and the four rows of the [P22] grid under P.22 of cues3531.pdf print the same statements in the same order. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2025_sanitation.do imports 3531_num.csv with case(preserve) and in the aicomfort block loops gen item = the literal column name over P22_1 P22_2 P22_3 P22_4, so the IRW item code IS the source column name -- nothing positional, Step 5b exempt, no verification_*.csv / verify_*.R written. CHECKED ANYWAY AND DECISIVELY, with no Redivis export: applying the do-file's own filter (98 N.S. and 99 N.C. set to missing) to 3531_num.csv (N=2427) gives per-column n P22_1 2400, P22_2 2384, P22_3 2392, P22_4 2396, and irw::irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE) returns exactly 2400 / 2384 / 2392 / 2396, n_rows 9572 = their sum. The four counts are mutually distinct, so every item is distinguished from every other. Source cell counts (1..10, 98, 99): P22_1 1196/198/187/173/225/131/102/94/26/68/22/5; P22_2 792/109/145/130/309/167/207/276/97/152/30/13; P22_3 646/114/139/127/391/204/261/265/101/144/29/6; P22_4 943/201/182/174/303/166/156/141/49/81/24/7. Content reads coherently (route 8): talking to an AI during a consultation is the least comfortable (1196 of 2400 at 1) and AI reading X-rays the most accepted. text_source=study_materials: the Spanish in instructions, item_text and option_text is transcribed from CIS's own questionnaire and .sav. DEVIATION from the .sav, deliberate: P22_4's variable label ends '...asistente virtual con IA', while the administered questionnaire wording continues '(inteligencia artificial)'; item_text ships the questionnaire's full wording. The other three item_text strings equal the .sav labels. instructions is the complete P.22 carrier question verbatim, joined across the PDF's line breaks; P.22 carries no interviewer direction. section_prompt blank, one trivial section_id -- a single flat grid. OPTION TEXT: only the endpoints carry wording -- .sav value labels 1 '1 Totalmente incomodo/a' and 10 '10 Totalmente comodo/a' (leading numeral stripped; the questionnaire header prints them as 'Totalmente incomodo/a' and 'Totalmente comodo/a' in quotes), while 2..9 are labelled with bare numerals in both sources, so option_text and option_text_translated are BLANK for resp 2-9 rather than padded. RESP SET: live 1-10 for every item (10 levels each per irw_table_sets); 98/99 dropped to missing by the .do file, so no option rows for them. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes no English version of Estudio 3531, so the English in the four _translated columns was produced by IRW. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Comfort with artificial intelligence in healthcare' matches the P22 block exactly and the live codes are literally P22_1..P22_4; the study is the Barometro sanitario 2025 third wave (CIS 3531), confirmed from the study page and the questionnaire header 'Estudio: BAROMETRO SANITARIO (TERCERA OLEADA) NOVIEMBRE 2025 Clave: CIS3531'. Sibling tables aiconcern (P23/P24) and airegulation (P25) come from the same file and were NOT touched. RIGHTS: governed by the CIS=allow row of instrument_rights_register.csv (Ben, 2026-09-22, widened to every CIS survey year 2026-09-23); originator confirmed as CIS. Applied, not re-derived; the clause was re-read on the percent-encoded page on 2026-09-24 and still reads 'permiten la reutilizacion de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' with the 'cesion gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual'.
public_note: Respondents rated each situation on a 1-10 comfort scale on which only the endpoints were labelled ('Totalmente incomodo/a' at 1, 'Totalmente comodo/a' at 10), so option_text is deliberately blank for resp 2-9; N.S./N.C. answers are dropped to missing by the IRW processing script; and the English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only.

'Regular' rendered 'In between'. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Concern over use of clinical data for artificial intelligence' matches P.23/P.24 exactly; no instrument mismatch. Siblings aicomfort (P22) and airegulation (P25) not touched. RIGHTS: applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow; Ben widened it to every CIS survey year 2026-09-23). Originator is CIS (Estudio 3531). Re-read the clause on the percent-encoded page 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200; sha256 2229d7eb9c10992935571930033904d28afd1aba60b8abe5870b3e3843836fcd, session-varying by design per the register): 'para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'cesión gratuita y no exclusiva' present. No register row written.
public_note: The English item and response-option wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes Estudio 3531 in Spanish only; P24 was asked as the follow-up '¿Y por parte de instituciones públicas?' to P23's question about private companies, so it asks about concern over public institutions using one's clinical data to develop health AI; resp 3 'Regular' was a volunteered middle answer that interviewers did not read out (17 and 18 respondents).

note: mapping_basis=data_labels: 3531.sav's VARIABLE labels tie each source column to its statement verbatim -- P25_1 'Legislar de forma especifica en temas de salud'; P25_2 'Informar al paciente cuando los servicios sanitarios utilizan inteligencia artificial en su atencion'; P25_3 'Dar la posibilidad al paciente de negarse a que se utilicen sus datos clinicos para desarrollar sistemas de inteligencia artificial' -- and its VALUE labels (identical on all three) tie codes to anchors 1 'Muy de acuerdo', 2 'De acuerdo', 3 '(NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo', 4 'En desacuerdo', 5 'Muy en desacuerdo', 8 'N.S.', 9 'N.C.'. The same three statements appear in the same order under [P25] in cues3531.pdf and as the row labels of Pregunta 25 in es3531mar.pdf. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2025_sanitation.do imports 3531_num.csv (varnames(1) case(preserve)) and in Table 14 loops 'gen item = "`var'"' over the literal list P25_1 P25_2 P25_3 -- the IRW item code IS the source column name, unchanged in case. Nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt under the derivation rule and no verification_*.csv / verify_*.R was written. CHECKED ANYWAY, DECISIVELY, cell for cell: applying the .do's only recode for this block (8 and 9 set to missing) to 3531_num.csv gives P25_1 1:906 2:928 3:9 4:364 5:129 (n 2336), P25_2 1:1369 2:795 3:4 4:175 5:62 (n 2405), P25_3 1:1174 2:854 3:9 4:261 5:89 (n 2387); the live table (irw::irw_table_sets per_item n 2336/2405/2387, n_rows 7128, and the item x resp crosstab of the locally cached copy table_context.R had already exported) reproduces all 15 cells exactly. The per-item totals are mutually distinct, so no permutation of the three statements or of the five codes is consistent with the data. TEXT: text_source=study_materials. instructions is the P.25 carrier question verbatim from cues3531.pdf (identical in es3531mar.pdf), including CIS's own 'con si las autoridades deberian de...?' phrasing; it names only four anchors because the midpoint is not read aloud. item_text follows the .sav variable labels, which the marginals match word for word; the ONE divergence is that the questionnaire PDF prints P25_3's last words as 'Inteligencia Artificial' (capitalised) while the .sav and marginals have 'inteligencia artificial' -- resolved to lower case on the 2-of-3 CIS sources, the same choice spain_2025_ageism_bureaucracy made for the same shape of discrepancy; not audible in a CATI administration. The interviewer marker '(NO LEER)' is stripped from option 3's text, following the batch_392 CIS precedent (spain_2026_disinformation_personalhumor). RESP SET: live {1,2,3,4,5}; the .do KEEPS code 3, so resp 3 is a volunteered, not-read-aloud midpoint chosen by only 9/4/9 respondents (0.4%/0.2%/0.4% of each item's n) -- disclosed in public_note. No option row for 8/9 (dropped to missing). Nothing padded. The whole sample was asked P.25 (marginals base N=2.427 for all three; 2427 rows in the deposit); 14 respondents answered N.S./N.C. to all three, hence 2413 live ids. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3531 in Spanish only, so the English in the four _translated columns was written by IRW. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Attitudes toward regulation of artificial intelligence in healthcare' matches [P25] ('limites legales de la inteligencia artificial en salud'); live item codes are literally P25_1..P25_3, so no instrument mismatch. Only the P25 block was extracted; P22 (aicomfort) and P23/P24 (aiconcern) belong to sibling tables processed concurrently in batch_398 and were not touched. RIGHTS: applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, Ben 2026-09-22, widened to every CIS survey year 2026-09-23, irw#2381); the originator is confirmed as CIS itself (cues3531.pdf header 'Clave: CIS3531', Ft3531.pdf 'ESTUDIO CIS n 3531').
